brief_item.title: ITME：面向LLM推理的CXL混合分层内存扩展
brief_item.core_conclusion: 长上下文与Agentic LLM将上下文状态推到TB级，超出单机内存。ITME用CXL混合内存暴露TB级可字节寻址的远程内存扩展，利用模型权重与前缀缓存的确定性访问模式主动管理数据搬移，相对传统CPU卸载最多提升35.7%吞吐。
brief_item.mechanism: CXL混合内存提供分层远程扩展；系统基于权重与prefix cache的确定性访问模式，跨内存-存储层次主动预取并管理数据搬移，借直接字节寻址简化软件栈，并提供超出主机内存的远程扩展以容纳大KVCache足迹。
brief_item.result: 相对传统CPU卸载，吞吐提升最高35.7%（上限值，条件为远程内存扩展承载超出主机内存的大KVCache）；性能用量产级SK Hynix CMM与PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSD验证，并以FPGA原型验证功能可行性。
brief_item.boundary: 仅摘要级证据，35.7%为上限值；具体工作集大小、模型类型与完整吞吐/时延曲线需正文；分层策略依赖确定性访问模式假设，对非prefix-cache流量是否成立未验证。
brief_item.project_relevance: [判断]直接相关CXL/解聚内存与KVCache跨域传输：将推理KV/前缀缓存外置到TB级CXL字节寻址池，直击长上下文与Agentic推理的容量极限；与DPU/JBOF NVMe-oF路径对比亦触及共享上下文的替代方案。

facts.title: ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories
facts.event_hint: Proposes CXL-hybrid tiered memory expansion to give LLM inference a TB-scale byte-addressable remote memory pool, targeting the disaggregated shared-context scaling problem.
facts.problem: Agentic and long-context LLM workloads push context states to TB scale, beyond a single server; existing offload to DPU/JBOF via NVMe-over-fabrics still carries heavy software overhead and cost, and the ideal shared-context architecture is unsettled.
facts.mechanism: ITME uses a CXL-hybrid memory to expose a massive TB-scale byte-addressable remote memory expansion. The key insight is that model weights and prefix caches have deterministic access patterns, so the system proactively manages data movement across the memory-storage hierarchy, simplifying the software stack via direct byte-addressability and adding remote expansion beyond host memory for large KV cache footprints.

evidence.claim: ITME achieves up to a 35.7% throughput improvement over conventional CPU-offloading.
evidence.condition: providing additional remote memory expansion to accommodate large KV cache footprints beyond host memory limits

evidence.claim: Performance validated with production-grade SK Hynix CMM and PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSDs; functional feasibility shown via an FPGA-based hardware prototype.
evidence.condition: CXL-hybrid memory + PCIe Gen5 NVMe; FPGA prototype for functional validation

facts.evaluation_context: Evaluated with production-grade SK Hynix CXL memory modules (CMM) and PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSDs for performance, plus an FPGA-based prototype for functional feasibility. Baseline is conventional CPU-offloading for KV cache beyond host memory.
facts.limitations: Abstract-level only; full body not fetched. The 35.7% figure is an upper bound ('up to'); exact workload sizes, model types, and the full throughput/latency curves are in the body. CXL-hybrid tiering also depends on the deterministic-access-pattern assumption holding for non-prefix-cache traffic.
facts.project_relevance: Directly relevant to CXL/disaggregated-memory and KVCache cross-node transfer themes: it externalizes inference KV cache / prefix cache to a TB-scale CXL byte-addressable pool, directly addressing capacity limits for long-context/agentic inference. The DPU/JBOF NVMe-oF comparison also touches the DPU-offload theme as an alternative path for shared context.
